title: AutoRef: Harness Optimization for Agentic Multi-Reference Image Generation
title_zh: 自动优化图像生成缰绳

paragraphs.en: Recent image generation models can take multiple reference images as input and combine them into a new image. However, multi-reference image generation remains challenging: models may omit or duplicate subjects from the references, or produce images in which multiple subjects appear unnaturally copied and pasted. Recent work has proposed image generation agents that combine image generation models, reasoning models, and a harness, which is an executable program that specifies how reference images are interpreted, how generation is performed, how outputs are diagnosed, and how the final image is selected. In multi-reference generation, however, references play different roles and outputs must satisfy many criteria at once, such as fidelity to each reference and the naturalness of the whole image, so many parts of the harness could be improved, from how references are processed to how outputs are diagnosed. This makes it hard to predict which changes will improve performance and by how much, and good harnesses difficult to design by hand; indeed, human-written harnesses vary widely in performance. We therefore propose AutoRef , which optimizes the harness automatically while keeping both models frozen: a coding agent iteratively rewrites the harness code. AutoRef separates the tasks whose feedback informs proposals from the tasks used to select candidates, and continues the search from a beam of the top-ranked harnesses on the selection tasks. Using this procedure, we discover AutoRef-Harness , which improves the open-weight FLUX.2 [klein] 4B from 5.72 to 7.37 (out of 10) on held-out four-reference tasks of the MultiBanana benchmark, matching or exceeding proprietary models including Nano Banana Pro and GPT-Image-1.5. Without re-optimization, the same harness also improves results when the generator, number of references, benchmark, evaluator, or reasoning model differs from those used in the search. We release our code and AutoRef-Harness at https://github.com/KuOnoda/AutoRef .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的图像生成模型能够接收多张参考图像作为输入，并将它们组合成一张新图像。 然而，多参考图像生成仍然充满挑战：模型可能会遗漏或重复参考图像中的主体，或者生成多个主体看起来像是被不自然地复制粘贴的图像。 近期的研究提出了一种图像生成智能体，它结合了图像生成模型、推理模型和一个“控制器”——一个可执行程序，用于指定如何解释参考图像、如何进行生成、如何诊断输出以及如何选择最终图像。 但在多参考生成中，各参考图像扮演着不同的角色，且输出必须同时满足多个标准，例如对每张参考图像的忠实度以及整张图像的自然性，因此“控制器”的许多部分都可以改进，从如何处理参考图像到如何诊断输出。 这使得很难预测哪些改动能提升性能以及提升多少，也难以手动设计出优秀的“控制器”；事实上，人类编写的“控制器”在性能上差异很大。 因此，我们提出了 AutoRef：它在保持两个模型冻结的同时自动优化“控制器”——一个编码智能体迭代地重写“控制器”代码。 AutoRef 将提供反馈以指导提案生成的任务，与用于选择候选方案的任务分离开来，并基于选择任务中排名最高的若干“控制器”继续搜索。 通过这一流程，我们发现了 AutoRef-Harness：它在 MultiBanana 基准测试的预留四参考任务上，将开源的 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 模型得分从 5.72 提升至 7.37（满分 10），与 Nano Banana Pro 和 GPT-Image-1.5 等专有模型的表现相当甚至更优。 无需重新优化，当生成器、参考图像数量、基准测试、评估器或推理模型与搜索时使用的版本不同时，同一“控制器”也能提升结果。 我们在 https://github.com/KuOnoda/AutoRef 上发布了我们的代码和 AutoRef-Harness。

paragraphs.en: Recent image generation models can take multiple reference images as input and combine them into a new image ( Google DeepMind, 2025b ; Google DeepMind, 2025a ; OpenAI, 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . This capability, referred to as multi-reference image generation ( Wu et al., 2026a ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ; Huang et al., 2026b ) , matters for practical image creation because users can specify people, objects, clothing, backgrounds, and styles using separate images. Such control is directly useful in applications including advertising ( Inoue et al., 2023 ; Morita et al., 2025 ) , virtual try-on ( Zhu et al., 2023 ; Chong et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) , and content creation ( Ruiz et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Yet combining multiple references correctly remains challenging. Models may omit or duplicate subjects from the references, or produce images in which the subjects appear pasted in rather than forming a coherent scene ( Xia et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026b ) .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的图像生成模型能够接收多张参考图像作为输入，并将它们组合成一张新图像（Google DeepMind, 2025b；Google DeepMind, 2025a；OpenAI, 2025a；Wu 等, 2025）。 这种能力被称为多参考图像生成（Wu 等, 2026a；Xia 等, 2026；Zhang 等, 2026c；Huang 等, 2026b），对实际图像创作具有重要意义，因为用户可以使用独立的图像来指定人物、物体、服装、背景和风格。 这种控制能力在多个应用中具有直接价值，包括广告（Inoue 等, 2023；Morita 等, 2025）、虚拟试穿（Zhu 等, 2023；Chong 等, 2025；Hu 等, 2026）和内容创作（Ruiz 等, 2023；Xu 等, 2026）。 然而，正确融合多个参考图像仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。 模型可能会遗漏或重复参考图像中的主体，或者生成将主体简单“粘贴”上去而非形成连贯场景的图像（Xia 等, 2026；Huang 等, 2026b）。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has proposed image generation agents that combine image generation and reasoning models through a harness and iteratively plan, generate, diagnose, and refine ( Hao et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Ma et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2026b ) . The harness is executable code that specifies how the frozen models are used: how references are interpreted, prompts are constructed, candidates are generated and evaluated, and the output is selected. In multi-reference image generation, however, a good harness is harder to design than in text-to-image generation: references play different roles (e.g., identity, background, or style), and outputs must satisfy many criteria, including fidelity to each reference and the naturalness of the whole image ( Oshima et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026b ) . Many parts of the harness could therefore be improved, from which references to provide and in what order to how outputs are checked against each one, yet the effect of each change is hard to predict. Indeed, existing human-written harnesses vary widely in performance (Section 6.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究提出了一些图像生成智能体，这些智能体通过一个“协调器”将图像生成模型与推理模型相结合，并迭代地进行规划、生成、诊断和优化（Hao 等，2023；Yang 等，2024b；Ma 等，2025；He 等，2026b）。 “协调器”是一段可执行代码，它规定了如何使用这些固定模型：如何解释参考信息、如何构建提示词、如何生成和评估候选结果，以及如何选择最终输出。 然而，在多参考图像生成中，设计一个良好的“协调器”比在文本到图像生成中更为困难：参考信息扮演着不同的角色（例如身份、背景或风格），而输出必须满足多个标准，包括对每个参考信息的忠实度以及整幅图像的自然性（Oshima 等，2026；Huang 等，2026b）。 因此，“协调器”的许多部分都可以得到改进——从选择哪些参考信息、按何种顺序使用它们，到如何检查输出与每个参考信息的匹配程度，但每次修改所带来的影响却难以预测。 事实上，现有由人类编写的“协调器”在性能上存在显著差异（第 6.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Recent work on automatic agent optimization has expanded from prompts and workflows to executable code ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Miyai et al., 2026 ) . These methods, however, have largely been developed for tasks with verifiable rewards such as math ( Lee et al., 2026 ) and coding ( Lin et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , whereas image generation relies on noisy visual evaluation and provides little diagnostic information through scalar scores alone. We therefore propose AutoRef , which optimizes harness code while keeping the image generation and reasoning models frozen. To address these challenges, AutoRef separates the tasks used to propose harness updates from those used to select candidates, so that selection does not reuse the examples the proposer sees. It also runs an iterative beam search, in which the top-ranked harnesses on the selection tasks, rather than a harness chosen by the proposer, become the next parents.

paragraphs.en: Multi-Reference Image Generation. Reference-conditioned image generation has evolved from personalized adaptation to specific subjects, as in DreamBooth ( Ruiz et al., 2023 ) , toward general-purpose multimodal generation that incorporates multiple reference images. Recent models support flexible multi-reference image generation and editing ( Deng et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026a ; Black Forest Labs, 2026 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Google DeepMind, 2025b ; Google DeepMind, 2025a ; Google DeepMind, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2025a ; OpenAI, 2025b ) . In parallel, recent work has improved multi-reference image generation by scaling reference-conditioned training data and fine-tuning the underlying models ( Zhang et al., 2026c ; Huang et al., 2026b ) . paragraphs.en: We propose AutoRef , a method for automatically optimizing harnesses for multi-reference image generation. Existing harness optimization methods ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Miyai et al., 2026 ) primarily target tasks whose performance can be verified using discrete labels or executable tests. In image generation, however, a visual evaluator must estimate quality; failures are often hard to diagnose from scalar rewards alone, and repeated optimization over a limited set of evaluated examples can overfit to both the search tasks and the evaluator. AutoRef addresses these challenges by (1) separating the tasks used for harness updates from those used for candidate selection, and (2) using beam search that keeps the top- B B candidates on the validation tasks as parents for the next iteration. These choices adapt harness optimization to perceptual, non-verifiable image generation tasks. Figure 2 illustrates one iteration; Algorithm 1 ( Appendix C ) gives the full procedure.

paragraphs.en: Task Separation for Proposal and Selection. Directly optimizing against rich but non-verifiable evaluation feedback risks overfitting the harness to both a small set of search tasks and noise in the evaluator ( Huang et al., 2026a ; Luo et al., 2026 ) . We therefore separate the tasks used to propose harness updates from those used to select among them. We split the search tasks into disjoint sets D train D_{\mathrm{train}} and D val D_{\mathrm{val}} , and write J D ​ ( H ) J_{D}(H) for the mean of R ⁡ ( y , x ) R(y,x) over x ∈ D x\in D . Evaluations on D train D_{\mathrm{train}} provide feedback for harness improvement: scores, evaluator rationales, execution trajectories, and visual artifacts are added to the search history ℒ \mathcal{L} and may be inspected by the proposer. In contrast, D val D_{\mathrm{val}} is used only for candidate selection, and its scores and artifacts are never exposed to the proposer or added to ℒ \mathcal{L} . paragraphs.en: Iterative Beam Search. Selecting a single harness at each iteration can commit the search to a lineage favored by stochastic generation or noisy visual evaluation. We therefore maintain a beam of B B harnesses. At iteration t t , the proposer uses the current beam and accumulated search history to generate K K candidate harnesses. Each candidate is evaluated on both D train D_{\mathrm{train}} and D val D_{\mathrm{val}} , and the next beam is formed by the B B candidates with the highest J D val J_{D_{\mathrm{val}}} . The proposer is told which candidates were selected but not their validation scores, while training-side evidence from all candidates, including unselected ones and their generated images, is preserved in ℒ \mathcal{L} for subsequent iterations. In the first iteration, the proposer writes all K K candidates from the two initial harnesses; in each later iteration, it writes two candidates from each beam member. The search that produced AutoRef-Harness is traced in Appendix D .
paragraphs.zh: 迭代束搜索。 在每次迭代中仅选择一个 harness，可能会使搜索锁定在随机生成或存在噪声的视觉评估所偏好的谱系上。 因此，我们维护一个包含 B 个 harness 的束。 在第 t 次迭代中，提议者利用当前的束和累积的搜索历史来生成 K 个候选 harness。 每个候选体都在 D_train 和 D_val 上进行评估，下一个束由 J_Dval 最高的 B 个候选体组成。 提议者被告知哪些候选体被选中，但不知道它们的验证分数；同时，来自所有候选体的训练侧证据（包括未选中的候选体及其生成的图像）会保留在 ℒ 中，供后续迭代使用。 在我们的实验中，我们使用 B = 2 和 K = 4，并用两个 harness 初始化束：基础生成器 H_vanilla（即对用户提示调用一次的那个生成器）和 GEMS（He et al., 2026b）作为 H_init。 在第一次迭代中，提议者会写出来自两个初始 harness 的所有 K 个候选体；在之后的每次迭代中，它会从束中的每个成员写出两个候选体。 生成 AutoRef-Harness 的搜索过程在附录 D 中有详细说明。

paragraphs.en: AutoRef-Harness is the harness returned by AutoRef (Section 4 ). It draws three images from G ϕ G_{\phi} and makes all other decisions with M θ M_{\theta} : it generates drafts A and B from two differently structured prompts, keeps the better one, generates draft C from complaints about the winner, and returns the better of the winner and C ( Appendix F ). Each component was added in an iteration that raised the validation score, and alternatives like editing the winner in place were dropped ( Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: AutoRef-Harness 是 AutoRef（第 4 节）返回的框架。 它从 G ϕ G_{\phi} 中抽取三张图像，并使用 M θ M_{\theta} 做出所有其他决策：它根据两个结构不同的提示生成草案 A 和 B，保留其中更优的一个，再根据对获胜草案的批评生成草案 C，最后返回获胜草案与草案 C 中更优的一个（附录 F）。 与人类编写的框架相比，它在每个步骤如何针对多个参考进行专门处理以及各步骤如何衔接方面有所不同：每个提示都将所请求的每个元素分配给其对应的参考（§ 5.1）；两个草案在提示结构上存在差异，而不仅仅是采样方式不同（§ 5.2）；批评内容会明确提及所涉及的参考（§ 5.3）；此外，在选择阶段，系统会在进行成对判断前统计硬性失败情况（例如缺少参考），而后续草案只有在依据此规则获胜时才会取代当前草案（§ 5.4）。 每个组件都是通过提升验证分数的迭代过程添加的，而其他方案（例如直接修改获胜草案）则被放弃（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate on MultiBanana ( Oshima et al., 2026 ) , a benchmark for multi-reference image generation. We use the training and validation splits for harness optimization, while the held-out test split remains unseen during search. paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 1 , AutoRef-Harness improves the performance of FLUX.2 [klein] 4B on the four-reference MultiBanana held-out test split. Despite using the relatively small FLUX.2 [klein] 4B as its image generator, the resulting system outperforms all evaluated open models and achieves performance competitive with proprietary models such as GPT-Image-1.5, Nano Banana Pro, and Seedream 4.5. The gains from AutoRef-Harness also transfer beyond the model used during harness optimization: applying the same harness to the larger FLUX.2 [klein] 9B improves its performance, and replacing FLUX.2 with Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 likewise yields a substantial gain. These results indicate that the benefit of the discovered harness is not limited to a particular model scale or generator family. Importantly, we achieve these improvements without updating the image generator or reasoning model; we only change the inference-time harness. Per-metric results are reported in Appendix H.1 , and the harness further improves Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 after fine-tuning for multi-reference image generation with DyRef ( Huang et al., 2026b ; Appendix H.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Across Reference Counts. AutoRef-Harness is discovered on four-reference MultiBanana tasks but applies to different reference counts without modification. As shown in Table 2 , it consistently improves FLUX.2 [klein] 4B on both the unseen three- and five-reference settings. With three references, the resulting system outperforms all open image generators without the harness and remains competitive with proprietary models; the gain also persists in the more challenging five-reference setting. The harness likewise improves the other generators, except Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 with five references, where the generator itself fails and the harness cannot compensate ( Appendix I ). AutoRef-Harness thus does not rely on the four-reference structure used during harness discovery.

paragraphs.en: Comparison with Human-Written Harnesses. We compare AutoRef-Harness with human-written harnesses: Best-of-3 ( Ma et al., 2025 ) , GEMS ( He et al., 2026b ) , IPR ( Oshima et al., 2026 ) , and Idea2Img ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , which use 3, 2.7, 3, and 9 image generations per task, respectively (details in Appendix G.1 ). paragraphs.en: Comparison with Harness Optimization Methods. We next compare AutoRef with alternative harness optimization methods (details in Appendix G.2 ). Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026 ) uses the same tasks for optimization feedback and candidate ranking, and its proposer chooses which candidate to build on from the full search history. paragraphs.en: AutoRef optimizes against an automatic evaluator, so we test whether its gains hold for human raters. Four raters compared FLUX.2 [klein] 4B + AutoRef-Harness with each of four baselines on 50 tasks each from the four-reference held-out test split. For each task, raters see the references, the instruction, and the two outputs in random order, and select the better output, or a tie only if they cannot distinguish the two. As shown in Figure 5 , AutoRef-Harness achieves a 70% win rate against its base generator, FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (17% loss), wins more often than it loses against FLUX.2 [klein] 9B (64% vs. 24%) and Seedream 4.5 (63% vs. 27%), and is competitive with Nano Banana Pro (46% vs. 40%).
paragraphs.zh: AutoRef 针对自动评估器进行优化，因此我们测试其改进效果是否同样适用于人类评分者。 四名评分者将 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B + AutoRef-Harness 与四种基线模型中的每一种，在来自四参考保留测试集的四项各 50 个任务上进行了比较。 对于每个任务，评分者会看到参考答案、指令以及两个输出结果，这些内容以随机顺序呈现；他们需选择更优的输出，只有在无法区分两者时才会选择平局。 如图 5 所示，AutoRef-Harness 相对于其基础生成器 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 实现了 70% 的胜率（17% 的劣势），并且在与 FLUX.2 [klein] 9B（64% 对 24%）和 Seedream 4.5（63% 对 27%）的对比中，获胜次数多于失败次数；同时，它与 Nano Banana Pro 的表现也颇具竞争力（46% 对 40%）。

As the evaluator and the proposer are replaceable, AutoRef may benefit from stronger VLMs and coding agents, and richer evaluators could be explored, e.g., combining a VLM with segmentation models ( Carion et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: We introduced AutoRef, a harness optimization method for multi-reference image generation that keeps the image generator and the reasoning model frozen and changes only the program that combines them. AutoRef separates the tasks that inform proposals from those used to select among them, and continues from the top-ranked harnesses on the selection tasks through iterative beam search. The harness it discovers, AutoRef-Harness, makes the open-weight FLUX.2 [klein] 4B competitive with proprietary models on MultiBanana, transfers to unseen reference counts, an unseen benchmark and evaluator, other generators, and another reasoning model, and adds to the gains of fine-tuning. These results suggest that how frozen models are used is itself worth optimizing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 AutoRef，这是一种用于多参考图像生成的 harness 优化方法，该方法保持图像生成器和推理模型不变，仅改变将它们组合起来的程序。 AutoRef 将提供提案信息的任务与在提案中进行选择所用的任务分离开来，并通过迭代束搜索从选择任务中排名最高的 harness 开始继续执行。 它发现的 harness——AutoRef-Harness，使开源的 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 模型在 MultiBanana 上的表现能够与专有模型相媲美，并且可以迁移到未见的参考数量、未见的基准和评估器、其他生成器以及另一个推理模型上，同时还进一步提升了微调带来的增益。 这些结果表明，如何运用已冻结的模型本身也是一个值得优化的问题。

paragraphs.en: Our method optimizes only the agent harness and does not update the underlying reasoning or image generation models. Thus, it does not introduce new behaviors through model-weight modification, although it can change how existing model capabilities are composed. As with image generation more broadly, improved multi-reference image generation may be misused to create misleading or unauthorized synthetic content. The harness also inherits limitations and biases from the underlying models and evaluators. We therefore encourage responsible use of the released code and harness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法仅对智能体框架进行优化，而不会更新底层的推理或图像生成模型。 因此，它不会通过修改模型权重引入新的行为，尽管它可以改变现有模型能力的组合方式。 与更广泛的图像生成领域一样，改进的多参考图像生成技术可能会被滥用，用于创建具有误导性或未经授权的合成内容。 该框架也会继承底层模型和评估器所存在的限制与偏见。 因此，我们鼓励负责任地使用已发布的代码和框架。

paragraphs.en: Test-time scaling (TTS), which improves model capabilities by allocating additional computation at inference time, has its roots in the development of reasoning in large language models ( Kojima et al., 2022 ; Snell et al., 2025 ) . This paradigm has recently been extended to image and video generation, where a growing body of work improves generation quality and alignment with human preferences ( Furuta et al., 2024 ; Onoda et al., 2026 ) by scaling inference-time computation without updating model parameters ( Yeh et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Singhal et al., 2025 ; Oshima et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026d ; He et al., 2026a ) . Beyond uniformly increasing computation for all inputs, adaptive TTS dynamically allocates computation budgets according to input difficulty or intermediate evaluations, aiming to achieve more efficient search ( Wu et al., 2026b ; Zhao et al., 2026b ; Guimaraes and Perona, 2026 ; Rawal et al., 2026 ; Saini et al., 2026 ; Jung et al., 2026 ) , with applications spanning image editing ( Qu et al., 2026 ) and joint audio-video generation ( Jung et al., 2026 ) . From a broader perspective, self-improving agents and agentic refinement, which iteratively alternate between generation, evaluation, and revision, can also be viewed as a form of TTS that leverages additional inference-time computation to improve solutions ( Hao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2026 ) . In this view, our work does not merely increase the search performed for each instance; it automatically optimizes the agent harness to find a more effective and computationally efficient inference procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 推理时扩展（TTS）通过在推理阶段分配额外计算资源来提升模型能力，其起源可追溯至大型语言模型推理能力的发展（Kojima 等人，2022；Snell 等人，2025）。 这一范式最近已扩展到图像和视频生成领域，大量研究通过扩展推理时的计算资源而不更新模型参数，提升了生成质量与对人类偏好的契合度（Furuta 等人，2024；Onoda 等人，2026）（Yeh 等人，2025；Kim 等人，2025；Ma 等人，2025；Singhal 等人，2025；Oshima 等人，2025；Zhang 等人，2026d；He 等人，2026a）。 除了对所有输入统一增加计算资源外，自适应 TTS 还能根据输入难度或中间评估结果动态分配计算预算，以实现更高效的搜索（Wu 等人，2026b；Zhao 等人，2026b；Guimaraes 和 Perona，2026；Rawal 等人，2026；Saini 等人，2026；Jung 等人，2026），其应用涵盖图像编辑（Qu 等人，2026）与联合音视频生成（Jung 等人，2026）。 从更广泛的视角来看，自我改进智能体与智能体式优化——即迭代交替进行生成、评估与修订的过程——也可被视为一种 TTS 形式，它利用推理阶段的额外计算资源来改善解决方案（Hao 等人，2023；Wang 等人，2024；Yao 等人，2026）。 从这个角度看，我们的工作并非仅仅增加每个实例的搜索量，而是自动优化智能体架构，以找到更高效且计算成本更低的推理流程。

paragraphs.en: Image generation agents combine prompt adaptation ( Hao et al., 2023 ; Datta et al., 2024 ) , tool orchestration ( Shen et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) , and visual feedback ( Yang et al., 2024b ; Wan et al., 2025 ; Kovalev et al., 2025 ) to improve model outputs. GEMS ( He et al., 2026b ) integrates iterative generation with trajectory memory and reusable skills. Related systems use tree search for multi-step editing ( Yao et al., 2026 ) or combine tool use and self-refinement with multi-reference composition ( Meta, 2026 ) . Beyond runtime refinement, reusable agent policies can be learned through reinforcement learning or experience distillation ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) , with some approaches jointly training reasoning, tool use, and native image generation ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) . Unlike these human-written or trained agents, AutoRef searches over the harness code itself while keeping all models frozen.

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 gives the full search loop of Section 4 . The search starts with the base generator H vanilla H_{\mathrm{vanilla}} and the initial harness H init H_{\mathrm{init}} , both run on D train D_{\mathrm{train}} , so the first history already contains their outputs (lines 1–3). At each iteration, the proposer reads the current beam and the history and writes K K new harnesses as code (line 5 ). Each candidate is run on D train D_{\mathrm{train}} (line 7 ), and its code, per-task scores, evaluator rationales, execution trajectories, and generated images are added to the search history for later iterations (line 13 ). paragraphs.en: The lineage of AutoRef-Harness (the pink path) acquired the components of Section 5 over the five iterations; scores in Figure 6 are J D val J_{D_{\mathrm{val}}} . Iteration 1 replaced the raw instruction with a prompt written by the reasoning model that states what each reference contributes, still with one image per task (reference-grounded prompting, § 5.1 ; 5.81 → \rightarrow 6.65). Iteration 2 drew two drafts from two differently framed grounded prompts and chose between them by a pairwise comparison run in both presentation orders (6.68). Iteration 3 drew both drafts from a scene-first prompt and added a third draft generated from a prompt revised for the current winner’s weakest criterion (6.81); the budget has remained at three images per task since. Iteration 4 based this revision on concrete complaints checked against the references and applied a hard-failure check to every draft before the pairwise comparison (complaint-directed revision and failure-aware selection, § 5.3 – 5.4 ; 7.30). Iteration 5 restored structural diversity: one of the two drafts became canvas-anchored, with the reference that sets the background or style passed to the generator first (structurally diverse drafts, § 5.2 ; 7.32).
paragraphs.zh: AutoRef-Harness（粉色路径）的谱系在五次迭代中获得了第 5 节的组件；图 6 中的分数为 J D val J_{D_{\mathrm{val}}}。 迭代 1 将原始指令替换为由推理模型编写的提示，该提示说明了每个参考的贡献，但每个任务仍只使用一张图像（基于参考的提示，§ 5.1；5.81 → \rightarrow 6.65）。 迭代 2 从两个不同框架的基于参考的提示中生成两份草案，并通过在所有呈现顺序下进行的成对比较来选择其中一份（6.68）。 迭代 3 从一个“场景优先”的提示中生成两份草案，并添加了一份针对当前获胜者最弱标准而修订的提示所生成的第三份草案（6.81）；此后，每个任务的图像预算一直保持在三张。 迭代 4 基于对照参考检查出的具体反馈进行了修订，并在成对比较之前对每份草案执行了硬性失败检查（面向反馈的修订与失败感知选择，§ 5.3 – 5.4；7.30）。 迭代 5 恢复了结构多样性：两份草案中有一份变为画布锚定式，其中用于设定背景或风格的参考被优先传递给生成器（结构多样化的草案，§ 5.2；7.32）。

paragraphs.en: The edit candidates repair the current draft by passing it to the generator as the first image, followed by the references and an instruction to change only the failing element. This direction entered at iteration 2 (edit repair, 6.54; canvas finish, 6.56, which also re-renders the draft under a single light). Its descendants reached 6.53 and 6.60, and the direction left the beam at iteration 3, and a later edit-based variant on the main lineage (complaint routed edit, 6.87) was also dropped. The proposer’s own analyses on the training tasks identify the causes: edits left the flagged failure in place on 8 of 12 flagged tasks, and the single-light re-render lowered the score of the draft it was applied to (6.16 → \rightarrow 5.91). Other single-step variants were dropped at once: cropping small subjects from their references (subject crops, 6.35), generating from the raw instruction and grounding only after a failure (plain first fallback, 6.29), and re-rendering the grounded draft under one light (grounded harmonize, 6.07). A second lineage branched off at iteration 3 (scene ladder pick, 7.06, three drafts from one scene-first prompt) and then wrote the scene as a structured plan from which several framings of the prompt were rendered (framing ladder, 7.05; plan verified ladder, 7.04). It remained in the beam until the end and, at iteration 5, also arrived at canvas-anchored drafts (canvas relit ladder, 7.10), but did not reach AutoRef-Harness.
paragraphs.zh: 编辑候选方案通过将当前草稿作为第一张图像传入生成器，并附上参考图像和仅修改失败元素的指令，来修复当前草稿。 这一方向在迭代 2 时进入（编辑修复，6.54；画布完成，6.56，该步骤还以单一光照重新渲染了草稿）。 其子代达到了 6.53 和 6.60，该方向在迭代 3 时离开了光束，而主谱系中一个稍晚的基于编辑的变体（投诉引导式编辑，6.87）也被淘汰。 提案者本人在训练任务上的分析指出了原因：在 12 个被标记的任务中，有 8 个任务的编辑保留了标记出的失败问题，而单一光照的重新渲染则降低了所应用草稿的得分（6.16 → \rightarrow 5.91）。 其他单步变体也立即被淘汰：从参考图像中裁剪小主体（主体裁剪，6.35）、在失败后才根据原始指令生成并建立参照（普通首次回退，6.29），以及以单一光照重新渲染已建立参照的草稿（参照协调，6.07）。 第二条谱系在迭代 3 时分支出来（场景阶梯选择，7.06，从一个优先场景的提示中生成三个草稿），随后将场景写成结构化计划，并据此渲染了提示的多种构图（构图阶梯，7.05；计划验证阶梯，7.04）。 该方向一直保留在光束中直到结束，并在迭代 5 时也生成了以画布为锚点的草稿（画布重照明阶梯，7.10），但未能达到 AutoRef-Harness。

paragraphs.en: The proposer is a coding agent that starts a new session, with no memory of earlier sessions, at every iteration. It receives two prompts: a system prompt that is fixed across iterations and provided as a Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) skill, and an iteration prompt that specifies the iteration, the number of tasks each candidate is evaluated on, the current beam, and the log files it may read. It gets everything else by reading files. In the excerpts below, split names are replaced by our notation.
paragraphs.zh: 提议者是一个编码智能体，它在每次迭代中都会启动一个新会话，且对之前的会话没有任何记忆。 它会接收两个提示：一个在所有迭代中保持不变的系统提示，作为 Claude Code（Anthropic, 2025）技能提供；以及一个迭代提示，用于指定当前迭代、每个候选体需要评估的任务数量、当前的束搜索状态以及它可以读取的日志文件。 其余的一切信息都通过读取文件获取。 在下方的摘录中，分开的名称已被替换为我们的表示法。

paragraphs.en: Figure 8 shows how AutoRef-Harness processes one task. The reasoning model first infers that image 2, the poodle in a library, sets the scene (step 2). It then writes two structurally different prompts (step 3): a scene-first prompt that describes the setting and then each subject (draft A), and a canvas-anchored prompt that passes image 2 first and places the other subjects in it (draft B). Both drafts pass the failure check, and draft B is preferred in both presentation orders (step 4). The reasoning model lists complaints about draft B, mainly that the violinist in image 4 does not match her reference and is not in the foreground, and its revised prompt produces draft C (step 5). Draft C does not beat draft B under the same rule, so draft B is returned (evaluator score 8.6/10).
paragraphs.zh: 图 8 展示了 AutoRef-Harness 如何处理一项任务。 推理模型首先推断出，图片 2（图书馆里的贵宾犬）设定了场景（步骤 2）。 接着，它编写了两个结构不同的提示（步骤 3）：一个先描述场景、再逐一描述每个主体的“场景优先”提示（草案 A），以及一个以画布为锚点的提示，该提示首先传入图片 2，再将其他主体置于其中（草案 B）。 两个草案都通过了失败检查，并且在两种呈现顺序中，草案 B 都被优先选中（步骤 4）。 推理模型列出了对草案 B 的批评意见，主要是图片 4 中的小提琴手与其参考图像不符且未处于前景，其修订后的提示生成了草案 C（步骤 5）。 在相同规则下，草案 C 未能优于草案 B，因此最终返回了草案 B（评估者评分为 8.6/10）。

paragraphs.en: An agentic loop with skills and memory. The instruction is routed to a matching skill and decomposed into yes/no requirement questions; each round generates an image, checks every question against it, stops if all pass, and otherwise summarizes the round into memory and rewrites the prompt from the accumulated history. The image satisfying the most questions is returned. We use the published prompts and the default four rounds, and show the verifier the references beside the image, since the original loop verifies single-image text-to-image outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 一个具备技能和记忆的智能体循环。 指令会被路由到匹配的技能，并分解为“是/否”形式的要求问题；每一轮都会生成一张图像，将每个问题与该图像进行核对，如果所有问题都通过则停止，否则将本轮内容总结存入记忆，并根据累积的历史记录重写提示词。 满足最多问题的图像将被返回。 我们使用已发布的提示词和默认的四轮流程，并在图像旁向验证者展示参考信息，因为原始循环用于验证单张图像的文本到图像输出。

paragraphs.en: Iterative self-refinement in which a multimodal model drafts several prompts, selects the best image, and writes feedback that, with a memory of earlier prompts and feedback, guides the next round. As this triples AutoRef-Harness’s budget, we also report a budget-matched variant: three prompts, one round, no feedback.

paragraphs.en: Our implementation of the Meta-Harness protocol, run with the same proposer, models, and evaluator as AutoRef. The proposer sees the full history of earlier candidates — their code, scores, execution trajectories, and images — and the candidates are ranked on the same tasks whose feedback the proposer reads, so there is no separate selection split. It has no explicit parents: the proposer chooses which candidate to build on, and the best candidate on these tasks is reported. We run it for five iterations, as for AutoRef (the original runs 20–40 iterations).
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 Meta-Harness 协议的实现，与 AutoRef 使用了相同的提议者、模型和评估器。 提议者可以看到早期候选者的完整历史记录——包括它们的代码、分数、执行轨迹和图像——而候选者则是基于同一组任务进行排序的，这些任务的反馈正是提议者所读取的，因此不存在单独的选择划分。 它没有显式的父节点：由提议者决定基于哪个候选者进行构建，并报告在这些任务上表现最佳的候选者。 我们像 AutoRef 一样运行了五轮迭代（原始版本运行 20–40 轮迭代）。

paragraphs.en: We ask whether harness optimization remains useful when the underlying image generator is already optimized for multi-reference image generation. DyRef ( Huang et al., 2026b ) improves Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 through supervised fine-tuning followed by reward optimization. As shown in Figure 9 , AutoRef-Harness applied to the original Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 achieves 5.69, outperforming DyRef alone at 4.91. Applying the same harness to the DyRef-trained model further improves performance to 5.90. These results suggest that harness optimization and model-weight optimization provide complementary gains and can be combined.
paragraphs.zh: 我们想知道，当底层的图像生成器已经针对多参考图像生成进行了优化时，利用 harness 进行优化是否仍然有用。 DyRef（Huang 等，2026b）通过监督微调结合奖励优化，对 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 进行了改进。 如图 9 所示，将 AutoRef-Harness 应用于原始 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 模型后，其得分为 5.69，优于单独使用 DyRef 时的 4.91。 将相同的 harness 应用于经过 DyRef 训练的模型，可进一步将性能提升至 5.90。 这些结果表明，harness 优化和模型权重优化能够带来互补的提升，并且可以结合使用。

paragraphs.en: AutoRef-Harness does not change the generator; it can only return one of the images the frozen generator produces. Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 exposes this limit ( Figure 10 ): the harness raises its score from 5.06 to 6.95 at three references and from 4.44 to 5.69 at four, but not at five (from 1.89 to 1.87; Tables 1 and 2 ). All harness steps still run at five references, but the generator rarely produces an acceptable image: the hard-failure check (§ 5.4 ) flags all three drafts on 87 of 96 tasks (91%), versus 9 of 96 (9%) for FLUX.2 [klein] 4B at five references and 7 of 96 (7%) for Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 at three. When no candidate is acceptable, better selection cannot help; overcoming this limit likely requires reducing how many references the generator must compose at once.
paragraphs.zh: AutoRef-Harness 不会更改生成器；它只能返回冻结生成器所生成的图像之一。 Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 暴露了这一限制（图 10）：当参考图像为三张时，该工具包得分从 5.06 提升至 6.95；当参考图像为四张时，得分从 4.44 提升至 5.69；但当参考图像为五张时则未提升（从 1.89 降至 1.87；表 1 和表 2）。 所有工具包步骤在五张参考图像下仍能运行，但生成器极少能产出可接受的图像：硬性失败检查（§5.4）在 96 项任务中的 87 项（91%）中均标记了全部三个草稿，而 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 在五张参考图像下仅标记了 9 项（9%），Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 在三张参考图像下则标记了 7 项（7%）。 当没有候选图像可接受时，更优的选择策略也无济于事；要克服这一限制，可能需要减少生成器一次需要合成的参考图像数量。

paragraphs.en: All figures in this section follow the layout of Figure 3 : the references on the left, each framed in a distinct color that also marks its number in the instruction (when the instruction numbers the references), the outputs of five methods, and the full instruction below. Figures 11 – 13 show three held-out four-reference tasks each, for object composition, local attribute transfer, and background and global style; Figures 14 and 15 show tasks with three and five references, counts not used during the search; and Figure 16 shows OmniContext. sents.zh: 图 11–13 分别展示了三个预留的四参考任务，涵盖对象组合、局部属性迁移以及背景和全局风格；图 14 和图 15 展示了包含三个和五个参考项的任务，这些参考项的数量在搜索过程中未被使用；图 16 则展示了 OmniContext。

sents.en: None of these tasks was seen during the search.
sents.zh: 这些任务在搜索过程中均未出现过。

sents.en: They were selected among the tasks with the largest score gap between the base generator and AutoRef-Harness, so they illustrate the failures the harness removes and are not a random sample; aggregate results are in Appendix H .
sents.zh: 这些任务是从基础生成器与 AutoRef-Harness 之间分数差距最大的任务中挑选出来的，因此它们能够体现 Harness 所消除的失败情况，而非随机样本；汇总结果见附录 H。

sents.en: In all settings, the harness removes the same kinds of failure: a requested reference is dropped or used in the wrong role.
sents.zh: 在所有设置中，Harness 都会消除同一种类的失败：即请求的参考项被遗漏或被错误地用于不合适的角色。
